Specification of Communication Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_CM_12003] Active subscriber when SOME/IP Network binding is used
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00103, RS_AP_00114, RS_AP_00120
⌈
In addition to [SWS_CM_12002], if SOME/IP Network binding is used to provide
services for an application, the active subscriber shall be an adaptive application for
which the SOME/IP services subscription has not yet expired when the
TTL
contained
in the respective SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup message has been exceeded (see
[SWS_CM_00205]).
⌋
7.1.4 Service contract versioning
In Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) environments the client and the provider of
a service rely on a contract which covers the service interface and behavior. The
interface and the behavior of a service may change over time. Therefore, service
contract versioning has been introduced to differentiate between the different versions
of a service.
